title: Grainy Flat
description: Illustration éditoriale numérique contemporaine définie par des aplats de couleurs et une texture granuleuse uniforme rappelant la craie. Elle présente une perspective forcée, des lignes tremblantes et des cônes de lumière géométriques superposés.
prompt: Contemporary digital editorial illustration characterized by flat color blocking and an omnipresent, heavy chalk-like grain texture. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Utilize a flattened, naive perspective combining top-down and frontal views to create shallow 2D spatial dynamics. Render objects as distinct, unblended shapes using {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} with pops of {{accent_color}}. Edges should be clean but organic, featuring thin, wobbly, hand-drawn contour lines in white or dark tones that occasionally break or jitter. Lighting is highly stylized and graphic; introduce stark, geometric, semi-transparent light cones that act as structural overlays, cutting across the composition. Shadows are solid, unblurred shapes offset from their casters. Apply a uniform digital stipple, noise, or pastel dust texture globally, giving the flat vectors a tactile, print-like materiality. Color harmony should remain high-key and low-contrast, avoiding muddy midtones. The interaction between the wobbly linework and the rigid geometric light beams creates a distinct visual tension. Emphasize a naive, playful structural approach where proportions are intentionally skewed to fit the graphic composition rather than physical reality. Avoid realistic gradients, subsurface scattering, or 3D shading; rely entirely on shape arrangement, bold color blocking, and textured overlays to define form and volume. contemporary editorial illustration, flat design, digital chalk texture, stipple grain, forced perspective, geometric lighting, wobbly linework, solid drop shadows, naive art, vector graphics, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame
